I've had a blast cooking on this thing (in the winter, no less!) and can't wait to take it on the road with me.

The propane attachment is very close to the handle and a "fat" propane tank was tricky to install  (need more practice) and rubs against the handle.  I wonder if this will wear the handle over time. The side tables fold in over the grill and I may have to protect the table from grease while on the trips.

Results.ReviewText:
Received this unit for X-mas as an alternative to firing up my Weber Spirit 3 burner grill for preparing meals for just a couple of people; overall, it is serving this purpose. 

Pros: Ignites instantly, uses less propane, good construction and materials, Weber quality. 

Cons: No "factory" provision for adjusting fuel/air ratio for grilling at higher (Colorado) elevation, so hard to get the grill to 500 degree temperature; low(est) temperature setting still too hot to slow cook items such as ribs without burning; folding side tables, while well designed, more of a nuisance than providing utility. I ended up removing them; should have asked for the Q1000 model instead.
Results.Title: Meets Expectations

Results.ReviewText:
Living in an apartment I’ve gone through a few different portable gas grills and they all didn’t last very long. The problem with most was usually a combination of being too small, having uneven heat and being made with cheap materials despite some having a higher price tag. 

This grill however hits all these points and more! I’ve had the Weber Q for a few weeks now and grilled on it about a dozen times and the food comes out great! Quick cooking times and amazing taste as well as being an easy clean. It’s the perfect size for a small family or even just personal use. Being very portable is also great for being on the move like camping or moving apartments. I do recommend getting the larger propane adapter as well and the Weber Q stand. I got both and it just adds to the already great portability and convenience. 

I will never go back to any other grill. The Weber Q is all I need!
Results.Title: Best Portable Grill!

Results.ReviewText: This is the second Q 1200 for my house. I use it frequently for small dinner cooking meats, seafood, and vegetables. When using my larger grill for big cooks of larger meals, I use the Q to cook the sides. Very versatile, easy to clean up.
Results.Title: Great for small meals

Results.ReviewText: This is the second Weber Q that we have owned.  It is great if we ever needed to pick it up and go should there be an earthquake.  I am prepared.
Results.Title: Perfect for out small patio.

Results.ReviewText: We have 3 Weber grills both charcoal and gas. Wanted a small grill for our farm porch. Bought a $100 grill from Lowe’s that didn’t last a year. So google best small grills. Read the reviews and bought this one for $200. Continue to be sold on Weber
Results.Title: Weber quality

Results.ReviewText: Took this grill on a two week camping trip.  The grill worked great, easy to use and nice portability.
Results.Title: Nice portable grill!
